question: Who is the author of the book 'The Great Indian Novel'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shashi Tharoor**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Shashi Tharoor** is the author of the book **'The Great Indian Novel'**, which is a satirical novel that reinterprets the Indian epic **Mahabharata** in the context of India's modern history and politics. 
• The book was first published in **1989** and is highly acclaimed for its wit, cultural references, and integration of Indian politics with mythology. 
• Tharoor, a renowned Indian politician, diplomat, and writer, is known for his command over the English language and his ability to blend humor with intellectual insight in his works. 
• The title of the book, **'The Great Indian Novel'**, is a play on the title of the classic work **'The Great American Novel'** and reflects the intertwining of literature and national identity.
